sections.title: Unit 1: Nuance, Focus & Emphasis in Narrative
body: At B2, mastering Hungarian means moving beyond what a sentence literally reports to what it implies. Hungarian is a discourse-configurational language: word order does not primarily mark subject and object (case endings do that), but rather information structure—what is known background (topic) and what is newly asserted or contrasted (focus).

In this unit, inspired by Dezső Kosztolányi's psychological novel Pacsirta (1924), you will learn how shifting a single phrase into the pre-verbal focus slot splits the preverb from the verb and completely transforms the emotional subtext of a scene.
